name: Swissôtel Bangkok Ratchada
short_description: A 407-room, 22-floor 5-star hotel on Ratchadapisek Road, a 2-minute walk from Huai Khwang MRT station in Bangkok's Ratchada business and entertainment district.
ai_summary: Swissôtel Bangkok Ratchada (formerly marketed as Swissotel Le Concorde Bangkok) is a 5-star, 22-floor hotel with 407 rooms and suites on Ratchadapisek Road, a 2-minute walk from Huai Khwang MRT station in Bangkok's Ratchada business and entertainment district. The hotel runs five dining venues -- including 204 Bistro's international buffet, Cantonese restaurant Loong Foong, and Japanese restaurant Takumi -- alongside an outdoor pool, fitness center, and Executive Club Lounge access for eligible room categories. Guests consistently praise attentive, professional staff and a strong breakfast buffet, and blog reviews call the rooms spacious and comfortable for the price point, though some 2025 guest reviews note the decor and furnishings feel dated and one reviewer flagged thin soundproofing between rooms.

407 rooms and suites across 22 floors, with panoramic city views from higher floors
Five on-site dining venues including Cantonese, Japanese, and European options
Consistently praised staff service and an extensive breakfast buffet
Outdoor pool and fitness center included for all guests

research_highlights: The Ratchadapisek location and 2-minute MRT walk draw consistent praise across TripAdvisor and blog reviews
Staff service and the breakfast buffet are repeatedly singled out as strengths
A February 2024 blog review called it a fantastic-value 5-star stay, with only minor gripes about a small in-room safe
research_watchouts: Multiple 2025 reviews mention the property could use a refresh in decor and furnishings
The hotel was formerly branded Swissotel Le Concorde Bangkok, which still appears on some older listings

faqs.question: How far is Swissôtel Bangkok Ratchada from the MRT?
faqs.answer: It's about a 2-minute walk from Huai Khwang MRT station, putting the hotel directly in Bangkok's Ratchada business and entertainment district. From there, guests can reach most of central Bangkok via the MRT and connecting BTS lines without needing a taxi for most trips.

faqs.question: How many rooms does Swissôtel Bangkok Ratchada have?
faqs.answer: The hotel has 407 rooms and suites spread across 22 floors. Rooms come with high-speed Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs, and city views, with select categories including access to the Executive Club Lounge -- a higher room count than most mid-tier Accor properties in the same Ratchada neighborhood.

reviews.title: Swissotel Bangkok Ratchada Review
reviews.summary: The Wayfaring Soul praised the spacious 40-sqm rooms, fitness center, and pool as strong value for a 5-star Bangkok hotel, with only minor gripes about a small in-room safe and no kids play area.
